Would Hit a Girl: He didn't hesitate to instruct Hirakoba to aim at Ryuuzaki Sumire in the middle of a game.

characters.name: Nanjirou Echizen
characters.description: Echizen Nanjirou is the father of the series' protagonist Echizen Ryoma. Nanjirou is very outspoken, eccentric, a shameless flirt, brash, perverted, and almost childish at times. He is known as "Samurai Nanjirou" for his mighty tennis skills during his earlier years as a professional tennis player. Aside from Ryoma, he is the only other player to have attained the "Pinnacle of Perfection". He was trained by Ryuuzaki during middle school and eventually became a touring professional after leaving Japan. He remains undefeated and was only one win away from earning a Grand Slam title before he unexpectedly decided to retire in order to raise his son Ryoma and teach him tennis. In New Prince of Tennis,he is coaching the Spain U-17 World Cup Team. Amazingly Embarrassing Parents: Poor Ryoma. Almighty Janitor: He was one match away from winning a Grand Slam title before suddenly retiring. Within the series proper, people have yet to challenge his skill (Ryoma even remarked that he loses to him every day). Berserk Button: In the anime, the merementionof Banji can send him into screaming fits. Big Damn Heroes:Like Father, Like Son.

characters.name: Karupin
characters.description: Karupin is Echizen Ryoma's Himalayan cat. Cute Kitten: A very playful Himalayan cat. Morality Pet:He is the only living thing Ryoma is consistently loving to. The only time Ryoma looks worried, afraid and sad is when he learns that his cat escaped from the house.Also with Kaidoh. He has a slight happy vibe after playing with Karupin. He is the only living thing Ryoma is consistently loving to. The only time Ryoma looks worried, afraid and sad is when he learns that his cat escaped from the house. Also with Kaidoh. He has a slight happy vibe after playing with Karupin.

characters.name: Rinko Echizen (née Takeuchi)
characters.description: A-Cup Angst: She is not amused when Nanjirou mentions her lack of size. It doesn't help that he's got quite theHands-On Approach. Love at First Punch: She was the first girl who didn't take Nanjirou's crap. Of course, they ended up married. She Cleans Up Nicely: The first proof of her growing feelings for Nanjirou is how she switches from a T-Shirt and baggy pants into a cute tennis dress. He keeps teasing her, though. He Who Must Not Be Seen: We barely get to see her face in the modern time stories. Slap-Slap-Kiss: She started offbickering a lot with Nanjirou.

characters.name: Nanako Meino
characters.description: Nanako Meino is Ryoma's cousin; she is a student at a local Tokyo college, who currently lives with her relatives, the Echizen family. She plays the role of an elder sibling figure to Ryoma, who is an only child and helps him and the other Echizens with their daily lives. She is sweet-tempered, very polite, loyal, and devoted. Deadpan Snarker: She can be pretty snarky sometimes, mostly towards Nanjiroh. Yamato Nadeshiko: She is the one in charge of the chores whenever Ryoma's mom is out, and is always demure and gentle... unless she's dealing with Nanjirou, that is.

characters.name: Satoshi Horio
characters.description: Ascended Extra: In the manga he is aFlat Character. He appears along with the other freshmen more prominently in the anime and the musicals. Attention Whore: He will inform everyone he has two years of experience in tennis (or other activities), whether the others want to hear about it or not. Audience Surrogate: He, along with the Freshmen Trio, are there to get explanations about certain techniques or game rules. Belligerent Sexual Tension: With Tomoka. Big Ol' Unibrow: His most visible characteristic.

characters.name: Kachirou Kato
characters.description: Kachirou Kato hangs around a lot with Horio Satoshi and Mizuno Katsuo. Although he is not very good at tennis, he thoroughly supports the team. He has a father who coaches at an expensive tennis club. Though he is normally polite and meek, Kachirou believes strongly in justice and fights to the end to defend his beliefs. As such, he has proven to be brave and stubborn when a situation calls for it. Ascended Extra: In the manga he is aFlat Character. He appears along with the other freshmen more prominently in the anime and the musicals. Audience Surrogate,The Watson: He, along with the Freshmen Trio, are there to get explanations about certain techniques or game rules. Beware the Nice Ones: Especially in the anime, where he isn't afraid of calling out Arai's bad attitude. A Day in the Limelight: An episode of the anime is dedicated to him confronting Arai about his smugness, only to discover they also have been pushing themselves to reach the Regulars.

characters.name: Katsuo Mizuno
characters.description: Katsuo Mizuno is the third of the "Freshman Three". He is a kind and soft-spoken person, but lacks confidence. Often when he does something good he would just consider it to be good luck or a coincidence. He respects his senior club members a lot and would never lose hope in them. Therefore when something is amiss within the club Katsuo would often get very worried, despite the fact that it does not concern him. Ascended Extra: In the manga he is aFlat Character. He appears along with the other freshmen more prominently in the anime and the musicals. Audience Surrogate,The Watson: He, along with the Freshmen Trio, are there to get explanations about certain techniques or game rules. Expository Hairstyle Change: In the last chapter of the series, Mizuno let his hair grow when they passed to 2nd year. This is a parallel to Oishi, who also used to change his hairstyle the following year. Flat Character: Compared to Kachiro and Horio, who at least they got some moments in the anime, Katsuo is the one of the Freshmen Trio with the less characterization.

characters.name: Masashi Arai
characters.description: Masashi Arai is a second year student and the best reserve player on the team, who is the closest to becoming a regular, almost getting a shot to play in Kanto Tournament finals in the anime when Momoshiro and Kaidou were nowhere to be seen. He is known for his hotheadedness and hazing of weaker players. He is as hard on himself as he is on the others during training. Although he had a very bitter relationship with Ryoma at first, he cheered him on during his match with Akutsu. Butt-Monkey: He lost games against Ryoma, doesn't make it into the Regulars during the series run and then gets beaten up by Akutsu. A Day in the Limelight: He receives more focus along with Kachiro in a filler episode of the anime, where he is revealed to be pushing himself to reach the Regulars and gains a newfound respect for Kachiro's determination. Hot-Blooded: Gets easily angry at any provokation, especially at Ryoma being cocky. Jerkass: Especially at the beginning.

characters.name: Masaya Ikeda
characters.description: Satellite Character: He is only seen with Arai as part of his group. Those Two Guys: With Hayashi.

characters.name: Daisuke Hayashi
characters.description: Satellite Character: He is only seen with Arai as part of his group. Those Two Guys: With Ikeda.

characters.name: Sakuno Ryuuzaki
characters.description: Sakuno Ryuuzaki is the granddaughter of Ryuuzaki Sumire. She is a kind, nice, and quiet girl with very long hair kept in twin braids, and often worries about Ryoma and the others. She starts playing tennis after watching Ryoma helps support the Seigaku team. Sakuno is attracted towards Ryoma and has feelings for him, she has not had a chance to tell him due to her own shy nature, a degree of bad luck, and the meddling of other people. In the manga, she is shown to be more intuitive, mature and a good tennis player. Out of all the girls in the story, she is the only one whom Ryoma shows his kind personality. Butt-Monkey: Poor little girl has pretty lousy luck, though not as bad as Horio's. Cute Clumsy Girl: She is very prone to accidents and mistakes, like falling randomly, bumping into bullies, or giving bad directions. Hyper-Awareness: She is quick to notice that Ryoma wasn't playing at his best during a practice matchbecause they both knew the girl who claimed to be his fangirl was actually a spy. Ryoma compliments her for this, which he rarely does to anyone. I Feel Angry: She's softspoken and polite, but not incapable of anger. Even when she has to call out Ryoma's behavior, she shows her discomfort, but doesn't shout at him.

characters.name: Tomoka Osakada
characters.description: Tomoka Osakada is Sakuno's best friend and classmate. Unlike her best friend, Tomoka is very outgoing and assertive. She is the self-proclaimed and very enthusiastic president of the Echizen Ryoma fanclub. She supports Ryoma along with Sakuno at the team's matches. She and Sakuno cheer together and are very good friends. Tomoka is attached to Ryoma, and she shows this more than Sakuno. Although her obvious crush on the boy, she stated that the only one she considers her love rival is Sakuno. She also can be seen arguing with Horio at times. Badly Battered Babysitter: Her little siblings are very,veryenergetic... Belligerent Sexual Tension: With Horio. He often tries to flex his two-year experience in tennis, but she is having none of it. Bully Hunter: Never EVER mess with Sakuno, Ryoma, or the Seigaku team! Clingy Jealous Girl: She will be very defensive against any girlother than Sakunowho shows any interest on Ryoma.

characters.name: An Tachibana
characters.description: An Tachibana the cute younger sister of Kippei. She is a member of the girls tennis club, and often supports her brother's team. An cares very much for her brother and her friends from both the Seigaku and Fudomine teams and tries to help them as much as possible. On the other hand, she has a rather explosive and even downright vicious temper that leads her to either get in trouble for the sake of others (as proved by Sakuno and Atobe) or become physically violent (as proved byKirihara). Accidental Misnaming: "Don't call me 'Tachibana-imouto'! My name is An!". Cool Big Sis: To Sakuno. Cute Sports Club Manager: She is the only girl seen around the Fudoumine tennis club, serving as support for her brother and the team, and knows every detail about her school team and rivals. Dude Magnet: Attracts men with her beautyandher firey personality.

characters.name: Shiita Urayama
characters.description: Idiot Hair: The tip of his hair is shaped like a swirl. Even when many fans claim it looks like an ice cream... just seePunny Namebelow. Keet: He is just like Taichi and serves as aFoilfor Horio. Punny Name: His name is a literalpoop joke. Suspiciously Similar Substitute: In Shinpuri he essentially replaces Katsuo (while Dan takes Kachiro's role) in the new "Freshmen Trio" with Horio. Tag Along Kid: He is this along with Taichi and Horio.

characters.name: Miyuki Chitose
characters.description: Gender Reveal: On Tezuka, who mistook her as a boy because of the hat. Girlish Pigtails: Hidden under a hat. The Nicknamer: She refers to Tezuka as “Thief bro” because he took her racquet. Even after clearing the misunderstanding, she still calls him this. One Degree of Separation: Turns out that Miyuki is the younger sister of Senri Chitose, old doubles partner of Kippei Tachibana and current member of the Shitenhouji tennis club, both schools rivals with Tezuka, who she casually meets in Kyuushu and indirectly helps him overcome his own yips, eventually allowing Tezuka to have a match against her brother. Plucky Girl: Despite her yips, she is very enthusiastic about tennis. Her bravery and energy is what inspires Tezuka to get rid of his own yips.

characters.name: Yuki Akutsu
characters.description: Ma'am Shock: One of the reasons the Seigaku Regulars think she is Kawamura's girlfriend is because he refers to her as "Yuki-chan", despite her being the mother of one of his childhood friends. This is because Yuki gets upset if he calls her "Aunt", "Ma'am", or any other name that will make her feel old. Mistaken for Romance: When they meet her, the Seigaku Regulars think she is Kawamura's girlfriend and that KawamuraLikes Older Women. She was actually asking Kawamura to keep Akutsu out of trouble. Morality Chain: Akutsu only agrees to join the U-17 training camp because her mother took the effort to gather all the pieces of the shredded invitation and put them together. Akutsu finds her asleep while gluing all the pieces. Teen Pregnancy: Had Akutsu when she was as young as 18-19 years old.

characters.name: Yumiko Fuji
characters.description: Cool Big Sis: Both Shuusuke and Yuuta adore her. Fortune Teller: She likes reading the Tarot, and she wrote the Horoscope book that Sengoku has. Ms. Fanservice: She is tall, slim, pretty and has a nice smile. Stacy's Mom: Or in this case "Stacy's Sister", after Mizuki develops a crush on her. Supreme Chef: Shuusuke mentions Yuuta loves her home made cakes.

characters.name: Mamoru Inoue
characters.description: Mamoru Inoue is a journalist for theMonthly Tennis Promagazine. Inoue takes a special interest in the progress of Seigaku. He is also an amateur tennis player, as well as being a big fan of Echizen Nanjirou. Ascended Extra: Only in the TV anime. Combat Commentator: He is the one who gives most of the tennis trivia and insight for theAudience Surrogates Crazy-Prepared: Always has his tennis stuff in his car, in case he needs it. Fan Boy: Of Nanjirou.

characters.name: Saori Shiba
characters.description: Saori Shiba is the new photographer for theMonthly Tennis Promagazine. Along with Inoue, she takes a special interest in Seigaku. Alliterative Name:ShibaSaori. Ascended Extra: Only in the TV anime. Audience Surrogate,The Watson: She mostly is the one asking the questions to get either Inoue or Ryuzaki-sensei to explain about the techniques or game rules. Butt-Monkey: She tends to be clumsy, like forgetting to take photos during a tennis match, or getting names mixed in some articles.

characters.name: Kitazono Kotoha
characters.description: Alliterative Name:KitazonoKotoha. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: Her strategy is to pose as a fangirl, act like the girlfriend-wannabe of the best player of the school she is visiting and gather all the data she can. The Bus Came Back: Briefly. She tries to flirt with Atobe with an obento, but he blows her off on the spot. Cute Sports Club Manager: From the Tsubakikawa Gakuen tennis team. Fangirl: It's actually an act. She has tried this on Ryoma, and later on Atobe.

characters.name: Kazuya Tokugawa
characters.description: Kazuya Tokugawa is a High School 2nd year participating in the U-17 camp. One year ago, he was beaten by Byoudouin and has had to crawl his way back up from the Loser. Even though he's quite taciturn, he is unexpectedly quite caring of his upperclassmen. Big Brother Instinct: According to extra material, he is inclined to have Ryoma as his little brother because he never had actual siblings, being a single child. Big Brother Mentor: He wants to be this for Ryoma. Perpetual Frowner: He is similar to Tezuka in this regard. He hasn't been seen smiling yet. Suspiciously Similar Substitute: OnceTezuka decides to leave the U-17 campTokugawa steps in to be Ryoma's mentor. He is also equally deadpan and stern like Tezuka.

characters.name: Kanata Irie
characters.description: Kanata Irie is introduced as a 3rd year High School Student. He was originally the leader of the 3rd Court. The rest of the camp acknowledge him to be amongst the strongest in the camp despite not being in the 1st Court or a 1st Stringer as it is revealed it is his own choice to stay in a lower court, similar to how Oni Juujiro is much stronger than the court he stays in. Catchphrase: "Nante ne" ("Just kidding") Dude Looks Like a Lady: His eyelashes are prominent behind the lenses of his glasses, and the form of his face is delicate compared to his teammates. Hidden Depths: He wants to be a doctor, so he works part-time at the U-17 cafeteria to save for his education. He also plays Tenor Sax. It's All About Me: Irie's play style was developed because he craves attention.

characters.name: Juujiro Oni
characters.description: Oni is a High Schooler first shown inThe New Prince Of Tennisand he is amongst the best Japanese school tennis players shown in the series. He is known as "The Gatekeeper from Hell". Big Brother Mentor: Fills this role for the middle schoolers, especially for Momoshiro and Kintaro. Cool Big Bro: He is this to the orphanage children. Fiery Redhead: AliteralRed Oni example. Friend to All Children: He volunteers for an Orphanage, where all the kids adore him. In Christmas, he dressed as Santa Claus and made wool toys for everyone, and gets touched when all the kids' stockings had as wishes to "have Oni as the Number 1 tennis player".

characters.name: Yuudai Yamato
characters.description: Yuudai Yamato was the captain during Tezuka's freshman year. He talks Tezuka into staying in the tennis club as Seigaku's pillar of support, calming him down when he was on the verge of quitting after being injured. Eccentric, insightful, and gentle, Yamato has a unique way of explaining things that even Sumire Ryuuzaki has trouble understanding. He continued to help the tennis club after graduation; in the anime, coach Ryuuzaki asks him for his guidance when they go to a training camp to prepare for the Kantō conference final against Rikkaidai. Big Brother Mentor: To Tezuka and Oishi. The Captain: He used to be Seigaku's former captain when Tezuka and Oishi joined the team. Chekhov's Gunman: He is only shown in flashbacks as Tezuka's main inspiration. He reappears in a filler episode of the anime. In the manga, he returns for the U-17 camp. The Glasses Gotta Go: In his reappearance inThe New Prince of Tennis, he has dyed his hair red and isn't wearing glasses anymore.

characters.name: Sotomichi Nakagauchi
characters.description: Sotomichi Nakagauchi is a 3rd year High Schooler known as "The Robot" participating in the U-17 camp. He eventually becomes No. 14-ranked Japan's U-17 Representative. Four Eyes, Zero Soul: His glasses give an eery aura around him Red Baron: "The Robot" The Stoic: He is known as "The Robot" because he rarely does any other expressions. Stone Wall: Gets Krauser'sSignature Moveand he still can go on.

characters.name: Issa Washio and Shun Suzuki
characters.description: Issa Washio and Suzuki Shun are introduced as the most capable doubles pair of the 2nd Stringers in the U-17. Together are among the very few doubles pairs that can achieve the renowned doubles technique Synchro. Anime Hair:In-Universe. Washio has light blue hair with black streaks. Heterosexual Life-Partners: They're also capable of using the Synchronization technique. Pointless Band-Aid: Suzuki. He has one on his nose bridge.

characters.name: Itarou Migihashi
characters.description: Migihashi is introduced as a 2nd Stringer High Schooler in the U-17 Camp as the strongest member and leader of the 2nd Court in the anime. In the manga, he is only listed as a player who is initially selected to go against the 1st Stringer's Top 10. It is said that players are unable to get points from him on his right side of the court. Ascended Extra: While his only appearance in the manga is a cover cameo, his role is expanded in the anime. Fanboy: According to his bio, he likes a girlband named "The Chocolates" (who Eiji, Momoshiro and Kaidoh are also fans of)

characters.name: Ryoga Echizen
characters.description: Echizen Ryoga is a high school tennis player not mentioned inThe Prince of Tennis, first appearing inThe Prince of Tennis - The Two Samurai: The First Game, later appearing in an OVA in New York in which Ryoma spots him training. According to his bio, Ryoga is Ryoma's half-brother, who was living with the Echizens after his original mother died, and then moving with his aunt. InThe New Prince of Tennis,Ryoga returns from America asJapan's No. 4-ranked U-17 representative. Aloof Big Brother: He is the only one who can get away with pissing off Ryoma. It's subverted later inThe New Prince of Tennis, as it's shown that Ryoga and Ryoma used to be very close when they were kids; Ryoma forgot about it since he was still very young. Big Brother Mentor: InThe New Prince of Tennis, he teaches Ryoma the Glowing Shot.All so he can have Ryoma at his best if they were to face off in the U-17 World Cup Finals and thenabsorb his tennis. Canon Immigrant: His original debut was in the first movieThe Prince of Tennis - The Two Samurai: The First Game. After fan acclaim, Konomi decided to include Ryoga as a canon character as well.

characters.name: Houou Byoudouin
characters.description: Houou Byoudouin is introduced at the U-17 Camp and he is the Number 1 ranked Youth Representative of Japan, which marks him as Japan's best U-17 player. He is the leader of the First Returning 1st Stringers, who have just returned from an Overseas Expedition. They get back to the camp to be welcomed back by the news that middle schoolers have joined the camp and witnessed them defeat a number of the Top 20. He decides to allow the inclusion of middle schoolers on the list of challengers for their places. It is also known that he utterly defeated Kazuya Tokugawa in the previous year. Always Someone Better: He lost to Oni in his first day at the camp, so he trained to try to surpass him. Jerkass: Doesn't hesitate to attack opponents who are already down or go full strenght on them despite being visibly injured. Meaningful Name: "Byoodouin" comes from the Byoudouin Temple, while his name means "Emerging Phoenix" The Rival: With Tokugawa and Oni.

characters.name: Duke Watanabe
characters.description: Duke Watanabe is a 3rd-year high school student, the Number 3 of the 1st Stringers and Houou's second in command. Aerith and Bob: He is the only member of the U-17 with a foreign name since he is half-French and half-Japanese The Big Guy: He is the more muscular of the 1st stringers. Red Baron: He used to be called "Destroyer" during his run in the French team. Undying Loyalty: He used to play for the French U-17 team, but switched to Japan after Houou saved his sister. Houou's injuries handicapped their match in favor of Duke, after which Duke offered to follow Houou.

characters.name: Juzaburou Moori
characters.description: Moori is a 1st-year high school student and a recent graduate and OB of the Rikkaidai tennis team that won the Nationals a year before the storyline. Introduced as the No.10 of the All-Japan Juniors, together with 3rd-year former Hyotei Academy captain No. 9 Ochi Tsukimitsu, they are the Super High School Doubles Specialists. Brilliant, but Lazy: As noted by Renji, he was one of the best players of Rikkaidai, but rarely went to train. Fiery Redhead: He is very passionate on the court. First-Name Basis,Affectionate Nickname: He calls Ochi "Tsuki-san". Jerkass Realization: Seeing how hard Yukimura worked in rehabilitation inspired him to take tennis more seriously and be a better player.

characters.name: Tsukimitsu Ochi
characters.description: Ochi is a 3rd Year High Schooler introduced as the No.9 of the All-Japan Juniors being known as the High School Doubles specialists along with Doubles partner Moori Juzaburou;, together as the Super High School Doubles Specialists. He was the Captain of Hyotei Academy and took them to the Nationals three years prior to the storyline, one year before current Hyotei 3rd years Atobe Keigo, Shishido Ryou, Mukahi Gakuto, Akutagawa Jiroh; and Oshitari Yuushi began attending their 1st year at Hyotei. Anime Hair: He has dyed white hair with color streaks. He is stated to change the color periodically. The Captain: He was Hyotei's captain before Atobe and the others started going to middle school. Odd Friendship: With his doubles partner Rikkaidai's Moori Juzaburou. Red Baron: "The Mental Assassin"

characters.name: Tetsuya Hara
characters.description: Hara was Shitenhouji's captain during Shiraishi Kuranosuke's 2nd year. He is known as one of Shitenhoji's Legendary Captains along with Taira Yoshiyuki, who was the captain the year before him when Shiraishi and Oshitari Kenya were in their freshman year. He is the captain that led Shitenhoji to the Nationals the year before Seigaku won. However for unknown reasons, Hara decided to retire from club tennis in the Spring of last year, meaning he didn't captain his team to that Nationals. He is currently a high school 1st year. Boke and Tsukkomi Routine: He likes going to comedy shows and practicing his "Tsukkomi" routine. The Captain: Part of the Shitenhouji's Legendary Captains. Catchphrase: He yells "What the Hell!? Who the Hell!?" when annoyed.

characters.name: Yoshiyuki Taira
characters.description: Yoshiyuki Taira is a 2nd Year High Schooler and also an U-17 Camp Representative Candidate for Japan. He went to middle school at Shitenhoji and was the Captain of the Tennis Club during Shiraishi Kuranosuke and Hitoji Yuuji 's freshman year. He always plays tennis while wearing a cap. He is somewhat unserious on the court as he as a habit of pulling funny faces on the court while playing hence the nickname. He along with Hara Tetsuya are known as the Legendary Captains of Shitenhoji. He tends to also make jokes while playing. He is the captain that led Shitenhoji to the Nationals the year before Seigaku won. However for unknown reasons, Hara decided to retire from club tennis in the Spring of last year, meaning he didn't captain his team to that Nationals. He is currently a high school 1st year. Boke and Tsukkomi Routine: He is the Bokke, while Hara is the Tsukkomi. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: He is a goof even on court, and he still is one of the Shitenhouji Legendary Captains. The Captain: Part of the Shitenhouji's Legendary Captains.

characters.name: Shuuji Tanegashima
characters.description: Tanegashima Shuuji was first believed to be just another strong 2nd Stringer in the U-17 Training Camp. However, it is revealed that he was a member of the 1st Stringers and the No.2 of the All-Japan Junior Representatives upon the rest of the Genius 10's arrival. He did not go with the team on their foreign expedition due to his hatred of airplanes. The Prankster: He had the habit of stealing Sanada's drinks only to annoy him. Teen Idol: According to the fanbooks, he was scouted as a model when hanging out with Kimijima (who is already a celebrity himself), and he usually buys magazines where he appears on the cover. Why Did It Have to Be Snakes?: Planes. Also, the reason he stayed in Japan instead of participating in the overseas expedition.

characters.name: Atsukyoh Tohno
characters.description: Tohno is a character first shown in the series as No. 8 of the All-Japan Juniors as they return from the Overseas Expedition and arrive at the main courts. His Doubles Partner and close friend is Kimijima Ikuto who appeared with him as the No.7. Achilles' Heel:Ikuto tells Marui and Kite to aim for his right knee. Blood Knight: All his techniques are named aftermethods of execution. Jerkass: Shoots balls at people for no reason.Even his doubles partner is fed-up with him. Hypocrite: He is constantly talking about torture, executions, and his playing style is based on how to injure other players. But as soon as he is hit on his bad knee, he starts wailing and screaming in pain. Seems like the executioner can't take an ounce of pain with dignity.

characters.name: Ikuto Kimijima
characters.description: Kimijima holds the title of "The Negotiator of the Court". He is currently cultivating a new path called Intellitennis. He is introduced as amongst the best School U-17 players of Japan and ranked as the No.7 U-17 player as a member of the "Genius 10". Kimijima is also the star of a TV commercial for "Cola Vita". Beauty Is Never Tarnished: When Kite decides to break his deal off, he aims a ball at his face, only giving him a small cut on his left eyebrow. Despite depending on his good looks as a model, Kimijima doesn't get mad, and rather looks amused by what Kite did. Dye Hard:In-Universe, as he has blond hair and dark sideburns. In the anime his hair is white. Manipulative Bastard: He is well known for doing negotiations in or out of the court.He offered deals to both Marui and Kite in exchange of destroying Tohno's knee because he has had it with him as his doubles partner. Red Baron: "The Negotiator of the Court".

characters.name: Akuto Mitsuya
characters.description: Mitsuya Akuto is the Former No. 17. His special technique was "Data Tennis". With his distinct intellect, he analyzes his opponents to determine the very best method of defeating them. Big Brother Mentor: Turns out he was the one who tought Yanagi how to use "Data Tennis". Dude Looks Like a Lady: He has a long bob, glasses and a thin body type like Yukimura or Fuji. First-Name Basis: He and Yanagi are revealed to have been close, as Yanagi still calls him "Akuto nii-chan" (or "Big Brother Akuto")

characters.name: Itaru Saito
characters.description: Itaru Saito is the specialist who plans how the players can improve their play and train their mental mask. He devises who will compete against each other in a match. Awful Wedded Life: His bio states he is bad at dealing with his wife. The Smart Guy: From the three teachers, he is the Data Expert and keeps tabs on all the players' stats.

characters.name: Yukio Kurobe
characters.description: Yukio Kurobe is the strategic coach who manages the training camp as well as the camp's substitute supervisor. Analyzing each student's data and planning tactical matches is his main duty. The Strategist: He is in charge of tactical planning.

characters.name: Ryuuji Tsuge
characters.description: Tsuge is U-17 Camp's Circuit Coach. He also seems to be the adviser for the dorms. He's in charge of training their physicality. He won't go easy on assigning them strict training. Standing together with the players on the court, he's the coach who directs their training. Happily Married: His bio says he is married to an American woman and he is very devoted to her.

characters.name: Nyudoh Mifune
characters.description: Nyudoh Mifune is the behind-the-scene coach who guides players with unconventional tennis. He is as tame as a ferocious pet. He is known in the camp as the "Drunken Coach". The Alcoholic: He is rarely seen without his canteen. One of his tests Extreme Omnivore: He is capable of taking Inui's juice without even flinching. Jerkass: In addition to theTraining from Hell, he made the guys dig a hole in the ground and bury their team jerseysand pees on them. King Incognito: Turns outhe was the Head Coach of the U-17 all along.

characters.name: American Team
characters.description: Kevin is the Captain of the American team participating in the US/Japan Goodwill Games in the anime. His wish was to play Ryoma in order to settle a rival/feud between his father, George Smith, and Ryoma's father, Nanjiro Echizen. Break the Cutie:In his past, courtesy of his alcoholic dad. Canon Foreigner: He is exclusively created for the anime filler. Hot-Blooded: Has a very volatile temper. Abusive Parents:Parental Neglectversion. No wonder Kevin was messed up.

characters.name: Anime Other Characters
characters.description: Canon Foreigner: He is exclusively created for the anime filler. Money, Dear Boy:In-Universe. There's no other motivation to form a tennis team. Canon Foreigner: Only appears in the anime. Drowning My Sorrows: By the time Seigaku regulars meet her, she’s a random drunkard who takes interest in Ryoma. Hospital Hottie/Hot Teacher: It turns out she is Tezuka's coach while in Germany.
